limitations: All files and SQLCipher libraries are isolated synthetic fixtures.
Two independent Dart processes use a fixture journal; not a production SQLCipher operation receipt.
No native file panels, sandbox Release installation, Keychain, personal library, computer use or Windows tests.
Filesystem absence/replacement does not prove a submitted operation never published; reconciliation never republishes.
Caller must retain staging and journal publication identity before publish; cleanup only after a durable success receipt.
